scope: Ostaszewo pilot only: main village spine, two connectors and short rural junction arms. Side streets and house layout left for manual work.
edition: Heading: Wydanie pierwsze PRL 1970–74; source material dated 1963/74, 1962/74, 1970.
historical_limit: 1970-74 edition used as an approximate guide for the 1968 scenario; individual road dates have not been established.
georeferencing: Four scan-neatline corner fit in historical Gauss-Kruger zone 4. Polish Pulkovo 1942(58) EPSG:4179 transformed to WGS84 with installed PROJ/GDAL. Approximate manual tracing, not a surveyed road reconstruction.
